response.courseDescription: 481 Principles of Population Health Foundation of population health including an understanding of the difference between population and individual heath, and the history, role, and practice of public health; epidemiological theories, concepts, and measures; social determinants of health and inequalities in health; population-based approaches to improve health; draws on a wide range of health research, aiming to apply principles and use examples related to obesity, chronic disease, diet, and physical activity.
